description: Article to YouTube. Turn an article URL, or a block of text, into a narrated video with captions. Returns a job id right away. Call get_article_video with that job_id until status is done, then use mp4_url. Requires an API key and charges video credits when the job is queued. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

text.description: Article text, when there is no URL.

url.description: Article URL to turn into a video.

visual_style.description: Visual style id. Defaults to the standard explainer.

name: generate_article_video
title: Article to YouTube
